correctness.rationale: The estimator is the Euclidean projection, not Sobolev projection; only the input/output norm uses Q=I+gamma D^T D. Every contiguous block composition has a strict KKT interior: take centered strictly decreasing residuals inside each block (all proper prefix sums positive) and strictly increasing block means. On that cell P is block averaging. For a straight segment the finitely many affine pieces give the maximum-cell norm bound by summing segment lengths, also on faces by continuity. Inside any strict cell a small displacement in an operator-norm maximizing direction gives an actual sharp pair. Independently, with B the block-indicator matrix and G=(B^TB)^(-1), I compressed the nonzero eigenvalues of Q^(-1) E Q E to those of G(B^T Q B)G(B^T Q^(-1)B); the exact factorization for n=2,3,4 and KKT checks for both printed attaining pairs are replayable with python /workspace/checks/2.py using SymPy (output /workspace/checks/2.txt). The only nonunit largest roots are A, B, H as printed. H is strictly dominated, A-B has the sign of 2 gamma-1 and derivative 1/126 at equality. The crossing gives 15/14 and a derivative jump of 1/126 for the squared modulus, with all four maximizing cells at equality. The leading coefficient ratio is 14/9; n=2 has no amplification and the mirror pair-cells tie for all gamma>0 at n=3. No limiting argument for larger n or unsupported inference from numerical data is needed. The submitted checker was inspected, not executed.
